lines.1: 「We went together to visit relatives and took a trip to a nearby mountain.」
lines.2: 「The autumn leaves were beautiful, and before we realized it, we had gone deeper and deeper into the woods.」
lines.3: 「My sister said it would be dangerous to go any farther...」
lines.4: 「But I was enjoying the adventure, so I kept walking.」
lines.5: 「My sister needed the bathroom, and I told her she would simply have to go somewhere nearby.」
lines.12: 「Even a desperate search of the mountain found no trace of her.」
lines.14: 「Was it one of those so-called spirit disappearances?」
lines.16: 「But the terrain around that mountain suddenly gives way to cliffs...」
lines.17: 「And there are fast-flowing rivers below them. The accepted view was that she had suffered some kind of accident.」
lines.18: 「That's like something out of a manga...」
lines.19: 「No... Such things are entirely possible. Accidents happen all the time even to people gathering mountain vegetables.」
lines.20: 「It is said that the number of people reported missing in Japan has surpassed one hundred thousand.」
lines.23: 「But because of me... because I was the one who wanted to go into the mountain, I lost half of myself.」
lines.27: 「Nothing I did was enjoyable. It felt as though a wind had begun blowing through my chest.」
lines.28: 「I became a teacher because it had been my sister's dream...」
lines.29: 「But it is neither enjoyable nor boring...」
lines.30: 「Doesn't your famous fortune-telling show you anything?」
lines.31: 「When I divine my sister's fate, I see only deep darkness.」
lines.33: 「So you should choose Kiriya, Kanisawa, or one of the many other girls instead, Tsushima.」
lines.34: 「Someone like me would only bore you.」
lines.35: 「There would be no great passion... We would remain neither close nor distant... That is how it would be.」
lines.38: Before we know it, the red sunset has faded into night.
lines.40: 「You are exactly what I was trying to become, Ms. Inori.」
lines.41: Neutral, never swept away by emotion.
lines.42: This is what it looks like when that ideal is complete.
lines.43: A heart chilled like ice could be warmed and melted.
lines.44: But her heart is truly like a willow... Something that slips away no matter how I try to grasp it.
lines.45: And because it has been this way since childhood, it has completely shaped her personality.
lines.46: That is who Ms. Inori is.
lines.47: By middle school, when I tried to change myself, much of my personality was already set. Most of the effort went nowhere.
lines.48: 「That is more or less the truth of it.」
